title: late-night crispy algerian bacon tagine
description: a savory, vegan-friendly tagine dish featuring crispy bacon, crunchy vegetables, and a tangy, jammy sauce. perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
add the chopped carrots and potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
add the chopped red bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
add the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
add the sliced bacon and stir to combine.
transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the bacon is crispy and the sauce is jammy.
serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
optional: serve with crusty bread or over couscous for a heartier meal.
